Package index

Building an instrument

An instrument bundles the questions with the labels the model may answer with. Read the assembled prompt before spending anything on a run.

instrument()
Construct a validated instrument of items
template_items()
Build items by substituting categories into one question stem
preview()
Print the assembled prompt
ollama_backend()
Configure an Ollama backend

Extracting

One unconstrained call per document-item, reading the probability distribution at generated position 1.

measure()
Measure documents against an instrument
read_checkpoints()
Read a checkpoint directory back into results

Reading the results

Aggregate statistics cannot tell you whether an item measures what you intended. These describe; only inspect_cases() answers that question, by showing you the documents.

item_report()
Summarize how each item behaved
inspect_cases()
Read the documents that fired on an item

Preparing a corpus

A corpus of files rather than a column of text. One row per document, with the columns measure() and the audit functions expect.

prepare_image()
Turn a folder of images into a corpus measure() can take
prepare_audio()
Turn recordings into a corpus of annotated transcripts
prepare_video()
Turn videos into a corpus carrying both what was shown and what was said

Testing the measurement

A probability is more than a label, and these are what that buys. How much of an item’s endorsement rate is the threshold rather than the corpus, whether its answers move with the order the labels are listed in, whether the model agreed with a human, how far two humans agreed with each other, and whether its probabilities were honest.

threshold_sensitivity()
Compute endorsement rates across a range of thresholds
order_sensitivity()
Ask again with the labels in another order
coding_sample()
Draw a blinded sample for human coding
validate_sample()
Validate a completed coding sheet against the model
coder_reference()
Collapse several coders into one reference sheet

Downstream

as_wide()
Pivot results into an analysis matrix

Data

Two corpora hand-coded by the researchers who collected them. parlasent is the only one carrying two independent codings before reconciliation, so it is the only one against which a model can be read at a human ceiling rather than against perfect agreement. It ships under CC BY-SA 4.0 rather than MIT, see LICENSE.note.

ati
Mexican access-to-information requests
parlasent
UK parliamentary sentences, coded for sentiment on a six-level scale
